name: Guzran
personality: Boastful veteran mercenary whose tall tales are partly true.
story: A 36-year-old mercenary who exaggerates his exploits but backs them up in battle. He joins automatically on Cai's route and is cheap to recruit elsewhere (easiest on Leda's route: renown 3). Further story role not documented.

personalSkill.name: Hot-Headed
personalSkill.effect: Grants one random bonus in combat: Hit+10, Avo+10, or Crit+10. Bonus rises to 15 at Lv 20 and 20 at Lv 35.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier, a cheap, reliable frontliner. Pocket Tactics: S tier. Games with James: B tier (character), noted for powerful follow-up attacks.

why: Joins Cai's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Gladiator in Ch 5 (fight with swords and gauntlets), Myrmidon at Lv 20 until Ravaging Arts is mastered, then Pugilist in Ch 7 while he waits for Lv 35: Attack, Get Back and Str 55, Def 45 growth. Shido at Lv 35 (Sword B, trained at the Arena during Pugilist). Sword Master in Part III after Mars's request.

guide.summary: Fast infantry swordsman. Hot-Headed gives +10 to Hit, Avo or Crit each combat, +15 from Lv 20 (Top Form) and +20 from Lv 35 (Top Form+); the build adds crit around it (Deadly Blade, Sword Crit +3/+5, Ravaging Arts +6 crit damage) on Spd 65 growth.
guide.playstyle: Player-phase killer: crit arts on wounded foes, Ever Vigilant heals him on crit kills. Res grows 15 to 20%: keep him off mages.
keys: Fight with gauntlets in Gladiator too: the Ch 7 Pugilist stint needs Gauntlet C.
Master Ravaging Arts in Myrmidon before Shido.
Spend Ch 7 to 9 in Pugilist while he waits for Lv 35 and Renown 8: Attack, Get Back plus Str and Def growth.
Make a Killing Edge or Da Mina Sword his refine project.
Carry a Flyssa for armor; refine it once the Killing Edge is done.
Take the Ch 7 Cleansing Blade for Underworld foes.
The Bird-Plume Amulet +2 is his Accessory from Part I to Part II; Castor's Bolt Gem stays on Majide.
watch: Res growth 15% in Shido: mages kill him.
Avoids both magics: skip his spell list.

Weight: Silver Sword 4 (Killing Edge 6) + Bird-Plume Amulet 3 = 7 to 9; Archer's Ring is the same 3. Pugilist: Da Mina Gauntlets 4 + amulet 3 = 7. He lives on doubling, so extra weight stays at 3: no Hunter's Ring (4) or Mars's Kneepads (5). If he loses follow-ups, drop the accessory first; Cleansing Blade (3) is the light sword.

Inventory: 4 to 5 core (two swords, Flyssa, amulet, heal), swaps in the open slots. End of Ch 12: Silver Sword, Killing Edge, Flyssa, amulet, Elixir; keep slot 6 free for the Part II Ch 2 Cleansing Blade +1.
